symptom: `mxcli marketplace download <id> --output <existing dir>` fails with `write <dir>: rename <parent>/.mxcli-download-*.part <dir>: file exists`; only a file path works
cause: The command streams to a temp file in `filepath.Dir(output)` and renames it onto `output`, treating `--output` as a file path unconditionally; rename(2) onto a non-empty directory is EEXIST
insight: The temp-then-rename pattern decides the destination before it knows what `--output` names. Resolve directory-ness first (existing dir, or trailing separator = dir to create), put the temp file inside it so the rename stays on one filesystem, and join the CDN filename (or the content-<id>-<ver>.mpk fallback). Testable offline: `runMarketplace` + `marketplaceClientFactory` with one httptest server serving versions, the 303 hop and the CDN file — the CDN hop uses http.DefaultClient, which reaches a plain-http httptest server fine
